svg.title: One local browser for every website
svg.desc: An agent uses Ruin and Python Playwright to navigate shared Chrome. Marked agent tabs are reused in the background; subsequent actions use the returned current URL. Existing sessions and unrelated tabs remain.
svg.text: A / Any website, one local runtime
B / Start from what is already open
Exact destination tab exists → reuse that tab
Otherwise: unchanged agent tab → reuse it
Otherwise: create a background tab; preserve user tabs
After a redirect, use the returned URL for the next call.
Clicks and Enter run through the existing Ruin executor.
Site adapters are helpers; they do not define the browser’s scope.
